market_outlook.short_term: Markets face headwinds from 90% rate-hike probability and $108 oil, but Dow +500 and S&P rally show resilience. Expect volatility around FOMC. Energy and defense outperform; consumer discretionary lags. Diesel at $6/gallon pressures transportation and retail margins. Credit markets show early stress (French inversion).
market_outlook.long_term: Higher rates as structural normal reshape valuations. AI safety regulation may moderate but not stop sector growth. Energy transition (storage, electrification) is multi-year theme. Geopolitical fragmentation (BRICS, Modi diplomacy) creates trade realignment. Space sector institutionalization accelerates. Consumer value shift is structural.
